7111.title: ACP question presentation loses field structure
7111.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP reader drops choice descriptions and concatenates matching message/title text; the payload and renderer have no separate heading.
7111.proposedFix: Preserve option explanations, deduplicate repeated context/title, and design an OMP-specific heading contract across the domain and shared form while preserving answer mapping.
7111.caveats: Planner regression and actual server-rendered QuestionForm repeated in two clean trusted-main checkouts. Browser unavailable because Chrome is absent; no screenshots, computed font weights, mobile, real OMP, or Connect session verified. Full fix exceeds the one-subsystem/no-schema-change autopilot gate. Reproduction source and output are inline in the HTML; no raw artifacts are published.
